mechanism_narrative: A continued recovery in WORKPLACES mobility raises weekday trips, which spills into nearby retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days when WORKPLACES rises or stabilizes for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT stops improving and falls back from its current depressed level, discretionary trips become harder, reducing retail-and-recreation visits and pushing RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above its prior 2-week mean by 5 points or more
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite a transit decline or no improvement relative to the prior two-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while PARKS remain weak, more leisure time is absorbed locally rather than in retail corridors, so RETAIL_REC drifts lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and PARKS remain below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp additional decline in WORKPLACES indicates renewed restrictions or employer caution; within one week this suppresses shopping trips and pulls RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by 5 points or more week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after a week-on-week WORKPLACES drop of at least 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC reflects broader errand consolidation and neighborhood activity, which sustains retail mobility above the recent four-week average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to remain above its last-four-week mean despite GROCERY_PHARM holding near or above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility signals favorable weather and outdoor leisure demand, and that same outdoor activity carries into shopping trips, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by 8 points or more week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after PARKS increases by at least 8 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated while TRANSIT stays deeply negative, mobility is being held close to home rather than in mixed-use destinations, so RETAIL_REC stays below the prior month over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline and TRANSIT remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent narrowing of the gap between WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates commuting normalization; as that gap closes, retail visits should continue recovering and RETAIL_REC should rise over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES exceeds TRANSIT by less than 30 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days when WORKPLACES and TRANSIT move closer together and the gap falls below 30 points.
